zambo.description: Zambo is the verifiable work layer for AI: 153 tools behind one remote MCP endpoint, memory and handover that carry work across AIs, and a verifiable AER-1 receipt for every job. No account or API key needed. Free tier: 20 calls and 1 wrap-up free every day, and picking up in another AI is always free. Day Pass $0.99 for unlimited use for 24 hours.
